description: Apartment very well located which is suitable for business trips as well as for tourism or family times.Very well served by transport, the Gare Saint Lazare being a few minutes walk allows you to go to Normandy, Versailles, and the forests of Saint-Germain en Laye or Marly Le Roi. The Gare du Nord, also close to the apartment, makes international travels very accessible.The apartment is located in the 8th arrondissement, the warm district of music and musicians.The spaceThe apartment has been completely redesigned and carefully renovated by an architect to comfortably accommodate 6 guests and a baby.The interior decoration was designed with a “Parisian” spirit, ensuring a cozy and stylish atmosphere where you’ll feel right at home.This space is ideal for both leisure stays and **remote work**, as **each room is equipped with a desk**.The entire apartment will be at your full disposal.There are **ceiling fans** in each room, a **large portable air conditioner**Sleeping dispatch✸ Bedroom #1🛌 2 Single beds✸ Bedroom #2🛌 1 Double bed✸ Living room🛋️ Sofa bedBathrooms / Shower room / Toilets ✸ 1 Shower Room 🚿 + Toilet 🚽(Shower + Toilet + Sink)✸ 1 Bathroom 🛁(Bathtub + Sink)✸ 1 Separate Toilet 🚽+ sinkGuest accessAll space is available during your stay.We will send you all access informations 2/3 days prior your arrival.Other things to noteThe apartment is equipped with:- A Frame TV. - Two shower rooms and independent toilets in order to live comfortably.Check-in is from 3pm and check-out before 10am.
